scenarios.title: Get Lamp Instance
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Clicking either button attempts to acquire a Lamp instance (via DeviceInformation query or GetDefaultAsync) and writes progress/result text to outputBox. On a machine with no lamp device, the expected result is a 'No lamp device found' error message.

scenarios.title: Enable Lamp and Settings Adjustment

controls.label: Adjust Brightness and turn on Lamp
Adjust Color and turn on Lamp

scenarios.expectedBehavior: Clicking either button initializes the lamp and adjusts brightness/color then turns it on, writing progress to outputBox. With no lamp device, expected result is 'Initializing lamp' followed by 'No lamp device was found'.

scenarios.title: Lamp Device Change Events
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Register/Unregister subscribe to the lamp AvailabilityChanged event; the lampToggle turns the lamp on/off but stays DISABLED until a lamp instance is acquired. With no lamp device, Register/Unregister report 'No lamp device was found' and the toggle remains disabled (hardware-gated).
